title: Model catalogue (DEC-0046)
description: Every model the estate may use, with the classes an L1 policy restricts by. The estate's catalogue is Fabric's registry/models.json, versioned with the app (Fabric ADR-0147); prices are a reference into the live feed, never a number here.

modelId.description: <vendor>/<model>, the form OpenRouter names models in, lower case.

modelClass.description: The closed vocabulary of model classes (DEC-0046). A new class takes a decision; a reader refuses an unknown one. `open-vendor` (DEC-0083): the model's vendor publishes its weights openly, which the catalogue's writer states; it is independent of `chinese-vendor`, which says where the vendor is.

admissionClass.description: A model class a spend policy or a grant may name (DEC-0083): every class but the descriptive `open-vendor`, which admits and excludes nothing (a deliberate exception to DEC-0046's every-class rule).

providerSlug.description: An upstream provider as OpenRouter's provider routing names it: a base slug (azure, google-vertex) or a variant after a slash (deepinfra/turbo).

providerRouting.description: Fabric ADR-0147 amendment 2: OpenRouter's provider-routing object, field names as OpenRouter spells them, which the key route's proxy passes on. It changes the upstream that serves the model, never the model; a profile's allow-list is unchanged. A provider is never both ordered and ignored (FAC-SEM-058).

order.description: Providers to try first, in this order.

ignore.description: Providers never used for this model.

allow_fallbacks.description: false: only the ordered providers serve; OpenRouter's default when absent is true.

sort.description: Rank the eligible providers by this attribute (OpenRouter's string form).

toolUse.description: Whether the model calls a tool through the estate's route, as last measured (Project Observatory's weekly probe).

classes.description: At least one admission class (DEC-0083): the descriptive `open-vendor` alone gives a policy nothing to admit the model by.

endpoints.description: The request shapes the estate's route serves this model through.

priceRef.description: The model's key in the estate's live price feed (Project Observatory's); the catalogue carries no price.
